prompts.text: I'm about to author a new skill in this repo — can you pull up example-skill so I can see how the conventions are applied?
Show me how Pattern 2 lazy runtime configuration is supposed to look — walk me through example-skill's config resolution.
I want to see a filled-in version of template/SKILL.md side by side with the real thing — show me example-skill.
Before I write config handling for my new skill, show me how example-skill does project-local-first config precedence.
What's the reference skill for writing portable Python scripts the way this repo expects? Show me its scripts folder.
Use example-skill to manage the real configuration for our production deployment.
Wire up example-skill to actually call our production API and report the response.
